svg.title: Article generation pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Flowchart showing a FastAPI backend receiving user requests, dispatching tasks via Redis to a Celery worker, which branches into keyword or reference pipelines that scrape, generate, and publish articles to WordPress.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the user authenticate with FastAPI?')
sendPrompt('What does the FastAPI layer handle?')
sendPrompt('What data does PostgreSQL store in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis act as a task broker?')
sendPrompt('What does the Celery worker do?')
sendPrompt('What steps does the keyword pipeline run?')
sendPrompt('What steps does the reference pipeline run?')
sendPrompt('What does the DuckDuckGo scraper fetch?')
sendPrompt('What does the article scraper with trafilatura do?')
sendPrompt('How does Gemini Writer generate the article?')
sendPrompt('How does Imagen generate images for articles?')
sendPrompt('How is the generated article stored in PostgreSQL?')
sendPrompt('How does the pipeline publish to WordPress via REST API?')
